recognize_zh: 這是透過目鏡拍攝的照片，圓形視野中布滿成片、大小一致的小型成熟淋巴球（核圓、染色質濃密、細胞質極少），偶見較大、細胞質較多的前淋巴球（prolymphocytes），符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）骨髓浸潤。
features: Sheets of small, uniform mature lymphocytes with round dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Scattered slightly larger cells with more cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes
Markedly reduced normal hematopoietic elements; occasional band/segmented neutrophils
Interspersed fat vacuoles within the cellular smear
Photograph taken through the eyepiece with limited resolution; nuclear detail and nucleoli cannot be assessed
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate/imprint smear, photographed through the microscope eyepiece, shows a hypercellular preparation composed predominantly of sheets of small mature-appearing lymphocytes with round, condensed nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Occasional larger cells with more abundant cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes, are interspersed, and residual granulocytic elements are sparse. The image resolution does not permit evaluation of chromatin pattern or nucleoli, and smudge cells cannot be assessed. In conjunction with flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, dim surface light chain), findings are consistent with involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells are often slightly larger with irregular nuclear contours and are CD23 negative/cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive, which requires immunophenotyping to separate.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic transformation / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes exceeding about 15% of lymphoid cells (larger cells with a prominent central nucleolus) indicate progression, whereas here they are only occasional.
These show plasmacytoid or villous cells and are typically CD5 and CD23 negative on flow cytometry.
Hematogones have homogeneous fine chromatin and a maturing polyclonal B-cell pattern on flow cytometry, without monotypic light chain restriction.
